content: मोहन {%a.%} (-नी|{%f.%}) [मुह्-णिच्-ल्यु ल्युट् वा] .²1 Stupefying. .²2 Bewildering, perplexing, puzzling; तमस्त्वज्ञानजं विद्धि मोहनं सर्वदेहिनाम् <ls>Bg. 14. 8</ls>. .²3 Deluding, infatuating. .²4 Fascinating, enrapturing; सकलेन्द्रियमोहनानि <ls>U. 1. 36</ls>; <ls>Māl. 6. 8</ls>. .{@-नः@} .²1 An epithet of Śiva. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of one of the five arrows of Cupid. .²3 The Thorn-apple (धत्तूर). .{@-नी@} .²1 A particular illusion. .²2 A particular incantation. .²3 One of the nine शक्तिs of Viṣṇu. .{@-नम्@} .²1 Stupefying. .²2 Bewildering, perplexing, puzzling. .²3 Stupor; loss of sensation. .²4 Infatuation, delusion, mistake. .²5 A seduction, temptation. .²6 Sexual intercourse; योषितः पतितकाञ्चनकाञ्चौ मोहनातिरभसेन नितम्बे <ls>Śi. 10. 85</ls>; <ls>Māl. 4</ls>. .²7 A means employed in perplexing others. .²8 A magical charm employed to bewilder an enemy.
